title: The Well Of Abu Jahl
body:
As-Salamu Alaikum Ya Hadhirun. Salams on those who are present. Salam/peace descends
from Heavens. May we be granted from that Salam also. Allah Almighty greets His servants with
Salam. Allahu Akbar! Allahu Akbar wa Lillah al Hamd. Shukur our Lord. Allahu Akbar. Today
is Rabi-ul Awwal, the month of the birth of our Prophet (sas), the night of his holy birth- we
celebrated it. With it came joy on us. Glad tidings came to us. Power came to us. There is no one
who opens his hands & returns empty handed. There is no one who goes to the door of the
Sultan & returns empty handed. O Lord, may this ignorance leave us. It has become "Ignorance
covered the world. If you ask they don't know faith." We ask Your help & guidance which will
save us from ignorance for the honour of Your Beloved. We ask & expect from the Beloved (sas).
Our Umm Hiram Sultan also sends us support. May the honour of the honorable Companions
get more & more.
As-Salamu Alaikum Ayyuhal hadhirun. O who are present, salams to you. Dastur Ya Rijal Allah!
O mukhlas/sincere servants of Allah, O who love Allah, O holy ones who live on the way of
Allah's love! We ask your support. May you send us support. We may also begin, our way is the
way of sohbat. What is sohbat? Sohbat is the assembly which injects every person with the
strength he needs. When you run out of gas in your car, you go to a gas station. You go, fill up
your car at the station & go on driving. The secret is in that station, it fills up something. When it
runs out, you are finished & left. You start searching for gas. "My car ran out of gas. It ran out of
gas & it is of no use now". With each sohbat, a new power is granted to our spirituality.
Our physical being will perish & become earth. Our reality does not die. Our physical being will
die. It will be buried. It will become earth. They say "it came from earth & returns to earth".
Therfore everyday a new.. Yawm al-jadid, rizq al-jadid. You understand? Don't look here, there.

Focus your attention here. Yawm al-jadid, rizq al-jadid. New day, new provision. When the
children of Adam woke up everyday, the master of the house takes his bag, takes his basket.
"Where are you going to, Yahu?" "I am going to buy our needs. I am going to the market".
"What is there in the market?" "They have everything in the market. I may buy & come back. I
may buy what is granted as our share &come back" This is for our physical being. Yawm aljadid,
rizq al-jadid. Rizq- there is the material provision for our physical being & there is the
spiritual provision for our spirituality. Therefore man seeks provision for his exterior body and
also for his spirituality he seeks provision. It is this provision that keeps us alive. It does not crush
us & does not let us be crushed. It is a dragon! Our spirituality is a dragon.
"Our sermon is sohbat" said the great ones. And we are a weak servant, who is ordered to collect
& arrange the few words that they granted us & present it to the children of Adam. "Who are
you?" I am this, nothing. If there is no gas, the car... "Go yahu!" "How can I go?" "How were
you going before?" "But I am out of gas. I can't go when there is no gas. I need gas". A huge
vehicle goes. A huge plane flies & goes up in the sky. With what? Huge planes fly in the sky when
they take the power they need. Astonishing. If you throw a stone, it falls back on the ground. I
heard that there are planes that carry 1500 people, 1000 people. Don't corrupt your language.
Say "tayyara", the old word for plane. Tayyara/plane, don't use the imitated word for it. We
have honour. Say tayyara. Plane/tayyara is a vehicle. And us also, to make a short sohbat here
for whosoever is present here- one person, two people.. whoever is present here, they may listen
and "Innallaha yurkil hikmata ala lisan al waidhin bi qadari mustameen".
I don't know anything but they are making me speak. If there are donkeys in the assembly, givem
them barley. If they are human, give food. If he is a great person, give something accordingly.
Provision is of two kinds: for our physical being & for our spirituality. One whose animal side
dominates, constantly looks for food on earth for his physical being, for his stomach. One whose
spirituality is strong seeks from the Heavens, wants to rise to the Heavens. Subhan Allah. O
believer, listen! We made our words a little bit scattered but really we are saying them to present
the Bismillah. They call it dibaja, preface in the new imitated language. Is it not so? We made a
preface so that we start the sohbat, tell about the importance of sohbat. What is the heading,
preface of our sohbat?

Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim. Stand up! You are a lion! Who says the Bismillah is a lion. Who
doesn't say it is fertilizer. Therefore we said Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim. How beautiful, how
beautiful, how sweet. What an endless treasure. "Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar. Our army is
victorious, always victorious. Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar. Our army is always victiorius." Say
Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim. Don't fear. Now a lot of new, imitated weapons came out. Allah
Allah..Allah Allah.. When we say Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim we receive the power. I don't
know anything. I don't claim to know. But the Mercy of the Bismillah rains on me. There are
clouds in the sky. The cloud says "I am nothing" but it makes the mercy of rain. Without
receiving the order "O cloud, water this earth" it does not rain even a drop. Allahu Akbar. He
(swt) makes thousands, millions of tons of water wander in the sky & makes it fall as rain, as hail
or snow over wherever He (swt) likes.
O foolish ones, why don't you ask "Who is He Who does this?" You don't ask because who asks is
reasonable, he is human. Who doesn't ask, who doesn't seek but only asks for barley is not
human, he is an animal. Aman Ya Rabbi, tawba Ya Rabbi. To teach us, to inform us about our
humanity & the honour of our humanity the Lord of Heavens, our Allah, our Subhan created us.
He (swt) created us so that we know, so that we know.. He (swt) says "Don't be ignorant. Learn"
And what should you learn? You should learn what is beneficial for you. There are so many
maktabs... "Don't say maktab, Shaykh Effendi!" Say school, may your schools be destroyed.
What do they teach there? They teach nature. "You should praise 'that one' & curse that one".
They teach this. Ok, who should you praise? First you should say "Bismillahi r-Rahmani rRahim. All the Praise to You! All the Praise to You!" It praises Allah Almighty. Allah Almighty
is not in need of being praised. Allah Almighty in His Own Being is Hamid al-Majid. You should
teach this. You should teach What & Who is the One Who created you. That you will have some
familiarity, acquaintance with Him. The people of this time have no acquaintance with Allah,
not at all! They are acquainted with donkeys, with the foolish like themselves but there is no one
left who is acquainted with His Lord.
All of them ask when they see each other "How is your animal?" Astaghfirulllah. "How is your
ride?" Astaghfirullah. "I am sick". "Really? Your animal got sick?" "Yes, it got sick. I am going to
see doctors" "What benefit do you get from it?" "Well, they give me pills & injections. They make

surgery. They inject me with new life". "It is not with the doctors. What you ask is with He Who
created you. Do you ever say the Bismillah?" "How can I say the Bismillah? We never go to
mosque that we should say the Bismillah!" "So you have become an animal". Because animals
don't enter mosques. This is a new appearance.
"Have you ever seen an animal entering a mosque?" "No, they don't". "Who enters?" "Man
does". "Congratulations! Do you enter?" "No, we don't". "Ok, then it means you have become
from the animal category". People go to churches. They go to churches and ask for the barley or
other things they seek. "Who enters the mosques?" "Men enter the mosques" "Really, do animals
enter?" "No Shaykh Effendi, of course not. Do animals ever enter mosques?" "Is that so? How
come you are revealing your own name? Why don't you go to mosque?! Say! Why don't you say
'because animals don't go to mosque?' Who goes to mosque is man, who go are humans. They
are who know & worship their Lord. Men go to mosque, animals don't go". "Whip Shaykh
Effendi, don't fear!" Why should I fear? Is it they who give us our provision or is our death in
their hands? It is in the hands of Allah (jj). Even if fire rains from the sky, it doesn't burn the
believer but burns the unbeliever.
"Allahu Akbar, our army is always victorious". How beautiful. Tariqatuna as-sohbah. Therefore
our way is sohbat. We are explaining. If they say "you say wrong" may they fall in the wrong
well. And they will fall. Then they call (for help): "we can't get out of this". But you did this to
yourself. You fell into the well. Give me your hand" "I won't" "Ok then, stay there". You should
take the hand, they would say like this before. You should take a hand, meaning you should find
beautiful servants who know the Lord of Heavens & Earth & who keep His Orders so that you
take their hand: "O the servant who is honoured with his Lord's service, save us too" This was
the meaning of taking a hand. Now there is no one taking a hand. Because they don't take a
hand, they are taken by floods. Neither the Turk nor the Arab, nor the American, nor the
Russian, nor Chinese can't do anything because they fell into such a crisis.. They fell into such a
dangerous situation that no one can reach them.
Abu Jahl wanted to make our Prophet (sas) leave the world, meaning "let him die and we will be
saved from him". Abu Jahl had a well dug in front of his door. He kept himself, imprisoned
himself at home saying "I am sick". He rested in his bed & had a well dug in front of his door. He
covered the top of it, its surface so that whoever comes will fall in it. He thought of this with his

little mind, Abu Jahl. Then? "Then what happened Shaykh Effendi? Tell us its end" "O foolish
one, listen to see what is its result, so that you draw a lesson from every story". He put his wooden
bedstead..Let us not say bed, before they would say bedstead. So he had his bedstead put in his
room, right next to the window & he spread the news. He said "Tell people that Abu Jahl is sick".
Why did he do this? Because he would say for the Prophet (s) "he is an orphan". He is the Master
of the Universe, how can you call him orphan? But his little mind was only this much. He said "I
got sick. And that orphan goes to visit sick people. I had a well dug in front of my door & covered
its top lightly. The moment he steps on it, he will fall into the well & we will finish him.
He was laying like this in front of the window. Really our Prophet would visit the sick people.
Why? "Maybe his heart is softened. Maybe he accepts faith from fear of death". So our Prophet
went to visit him also, saying "maybe he will come to faith". Right when he reached this well, our
son Mehmet Effendi, he was about to take one more step on it when Jibril (as) came & said
"Return O Muhammad! (sas)" And our Prophet (sas) returned without stepping on it. Seeing this,
Abu Jahl got surprised. Saying "Let me run after him & call him back" he, himself fell into that
well! He started crying for help. "What happened to our master?" Mushriks came saying "what
happened to our Master? His voice comes but his self is not seen". They searched & searched &
finally they saw that he is calling from inside the well. And the well was not that tall. Only the
height of one or two men.
He said "take my hand & get me out of this" And they stretched out their arms. He was in the
reach of their arms. They said "Give us your hand" He said "I am reaching out". Those ones are
stretching out their arms from up, then? "Your hands are not reaching. Bring a rope or
something". So they brought rope & stretched it out. Abu Jahl is crying "It is not reaching. I am
going to be drowned here!" They brought rope & stretched it out. "It is not reaching!" What else?
"Find another rope". So they found another rope & threw it down to him. He said"It is not
reaching. It is not reaching. I am dying here. Look around in the neighborhood. Let them bring
a rope & save me". They brought all the ropes in 7 neighborhoods & threw them down to him.
Crazy Abu Jahl cries "Yahu it is not reaching.." They stretched out all the ropes they had but
nothing. Finally he said "O my soldiers, look. Even if you bring me all the ropes in the world,
they won't reach But him, bring him to me". He would call him "the orphan of Abu Talib".
Astaghfirullah. He did not speak to him with respect. "Bring me the orphan of Abu Talib, no one

except him can take me out".
Our Prophet, Sultan al-Anbiya (sas). O my beautiful Prophet.. They called him, our Prophet
Sultan al-Anbiya, Habibullah.. They called him & he said "let me go & see what he will say". He
came & said "O Abu Jahl, will you come to faith if I take you out?" He said "I will. Just take me
out". "Give me your hand" he said & pulled him out. "I have never seen a greater magician than
you" he said. Our Prophet... Subhan Allah, Sultan Allah. What a beautiful Prophet he is, what a
great character. He looked, "I have never seen a magician on earth like you" he said. He (sas)
said "Up to you".
The crisis that today's people fell into is this. "Let's change this. Let us put this law. Let us do this
to be saved from this crisis". Even if you had what is10x bigger than the America's treasury, it
wouldn't be enough for you. You will be left in that hole, you will die there. "Bring rope". So they
bring ropes from Americans, from Russia.. "We are populist, we are on the left.." Bring the ones
of who are on the right & on the left, get out in the arena if you can. 7 treasuries like America's
can't take you out.
Allah Almighty says, Astaizubillah "Wa A`tasimu Bihabli Allahi Jami`an"(3:103) "And hold fast,
all of you together, to the unbreaking Rope of Allah! Hold your tongue and I will save you from
that crisis". We have become like this now. They fell into such a hole that neither their law nor
their money can reach them. What money is it.. For 700 years Ottomans minted gold coins.
They were the high state. And you? "We printed paper money" they say. If you printed paper
money, why don't you print more as you like? "But we can't print" they say. "There is a law for it.
If we print as much as we like, our money will look like its picture in the newspapers. We can't
get out of this!" "Do you have gold?" "No". "If you don't, then you will perish. You didn't like the
Ottomans & kicked them out. Ottoman's last Sultan ruled for 40 years & everyone had gold
&silver in his pocket. Did you mint a single gold coin?"
They fell into such a crisis that they can't get out of it. None of the measures they take is enough.
It is not only our country but the countries of the whole world, little countries, emirates.. All of
their situation is like this. They can't be saved.. Of course you can't be saved. You have to hold
that Prophet's hand (sas). O Glorious Prophet! With the permission of your Lord Ta'ala &
Taqaddas Hz send us a Sultan who will rule us & save us from the hands of tyrants. We should
pull ourselves together, know our servanthood & try to make our akhirah be prosperous. This is

it. Who doesn't say Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim cannot find any goodness! He will be burned,
destroyed, fall into miseries & perish. Hang the Bismillah high. Fire does not burn the place
where there is the Bismillah. Be careful. Earthquakes don't destroy it, floods don't carry it away.
Be careful.
O our Lord! You are Subhan, You are Sultan! I say tawba for myself also. We repent for Your
servants also, tawba Ya Rabbi. O our Lord! May You forgive us. Send us a Sultan. Tawba Ya
Rabbi, tawba Ya Rabbi.. "What will you do with a Sultan?" Now everyone thinks of himself as
Sultan! They make a stand & all who come up there speak like a Sultan. And what work do they
achieve? Nothing! Nothing! Do they ever do any work? One of them said "Yahu, let us go to WC
at least to do some work". He can't do any other work outside. Wa min Allah at-tawfiq. O who
think highly of themselves! Keep this advice or else if you fall into the WC well no any Shaykh or
awliya can save you. Only the power of Prophet (sas) can save. Show respect for the Prophet! He
is the Caliph of Allah Almighty on earth, Khalifatullah.
Be careful & watch your mouth! Then a slap comes on your mouth, your mouth reaches your
ears & you will be left like this. A very famous person insisted- although they told him "you can't
enter here" he said "No, I will see". "No, you can't enter here!" 'That one' who thought highly of
himself said "No!" Whatever his occupation was, he insisted "No, I have to enter & see the holy
relics". "No! Don't enter". "I will enter". Finally they said "Ok, up to you. We don't interfere". He
took the 1. step, 2. step downstairs & on the 3rd step came a slap on 'that one's face that his
mouth went up to his ear. He was shouting "What happened, hold me". So they held him &
pulled him" He looked, his mouth is on his ears! They brought doctors. The doctors said "This is
not our job. His situation is normal in all aspects but his mouth is on his ear. We don't have a
medical field for this. Bring a holy person that he can straighten his mouth & face". So they went
& brought a holy one. He came, took out his shoe, hit him on the face with it & he got
straightened!" Now should we wait like this to be hit with a shoe for our mouth & face to be
straightened?
The shoe represents the wars. Avoid wars! "Wa As-Sulhu Khayrun" (4:128) says Allah Almighty.
Peace is better so try to make peace, He (swt) says. But they don't understand. Then suffer what
comes on you. May Allah forgive us. All of us are sinners. What can we do? We should ask

forgiveness from our Lord for the honour of His Beloved. We hope that every owner of right
receives his right & dunya finds its order. Tawba Ya Rabbi, tawba Ya Rabbi, tawba
Astaghfirullah. Shukur Ya Rabbi, shukur Hamd, shukur Hamd. Al-Fatiha.
This is a sohbat for the honour of the day of Mawlid al-Sharif & it is more than enough for 7
countries. Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim. Al-Fatiha. "Shaykh Effendi we don't know al-Fatiha"
"If you don't know, then say Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim & your work succeeds. Say a
Bismillah for your every work. And your work succeeds. Or you will be left as your mouth is in
your ear. Tawba Ya Rabbi...O our Prophet, may we be sacrificed in your way! Our ancestors
were sacrificed in your way for 1000 years & they brought honour & glory. They shook the world
with their Sultanate- the Ottomans. Now there are so many..Maybe 40 states emerged from what
the Ottomans ruled. None of them can succeed. We are their inheritors. We didn't appreciate
them either & kicked them out, threw out the gold & took the paper in. Ok then, suffer what
comes on your heads.
Tawba Ya Rabbi, tawba Astaghfirullah. Tawba Ya Rabbi, tawba Astaghfirullah. Let us say
Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim. The remedy for all your troubles is Bismillahi r-Rahmani rRahim. What opens every closed door is Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim. The Dominions of
Heavens & Earth stand with Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim. When you say Bismillahir-Rahmani
r-Rahim it can stop the running waters. What will stop the floods is not this measure or that
measure. One sincere servant of Allah says "Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim. O flood! Don't come
on us, go another way!" A mountain is ripped apart & it passes through it but doesn't touch those
believers. Tawba Ya Rabbi. Tawba Ya Rabbi. Al-Fatiha. May the barakah of the Bismillah
come upon your generations. Teach your children "O believers, say Bismillahi r-Rahmani rRahim". Shaytan stays away from them.
May Allah grant me some strength & I can do something too. I am left helpless. O Allah, forgive
me. Forgive me & send Your servants who will bring these servants into the forgiveness path O
Lord. Send us a Sultan. Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim. Sultan, Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim..
